learning_outcomes.text: Provides knowledge about public health problems.
Teaches health criteria in environmental engineering applications.
Provides the ability to understand problems that may arise from environmental pollution on human and public health.
Identifies measures to be taken against public health problems that may arise in environmental engineering applications.
Ensures the adoption of environmental and public health principles in engineering applications.

syllabus_topics: Introduction to Environment and Public Health
Effects of Working Environments on Occupational Health
Transmission and Contamination Routes of Infectious Diseases
Health Problems Encountered in Treatment Facilities
Effects of Solid Wastes on Health
Health Effects Caused by Radiation and Micropollutants
Health Effects Caused by Heavy Metals
